Delivery, provenance & how to read this guide

This is a standalone explanatory artifact created on 8 October 2026. Illustrations use invented checkout examples; they do not represent captured source, runtime traces, actual findings or recorded author intent. The screenshots are embedded, unchanged repository assets from docs/images/overview.png and guided-tour.png, with legacy branding.

  • Released: v2.0.0, published 29 September 2026, is the latest release observed. No installed version was freshly queried.
  • Merged, unreleased: PR #3 and PR #4 cover sequence/code and lifecycle work. PR #5 adds optional Monaco, PR #7 adds GitHub suggestions, and PR #6 plus PR #9 provide What changed in both renderers and draft recovery. Main was 607e18b when checked.
  • Unmerged work and research: decision log is absent from main; the previous local branch/worktree is no longer listed. Its preserved handoff is historical, not an available current control. The language-provider probe is in main but remains research without a production provider.
  • Source of descriptions: the audited README/ROADMAP/RESEARCH ledger plus inspected main at 607e18b, with authenticated release and PR metadata checked on 8 October. New source behavior supersedes the earlier prototype-only and Shiki-only labels. This is not fresh application browser verification.
  • Boundaries: static relationships are not runtime impact; dry runs are simulations; syntax changes do not prove behavior; explanation coverage does not prove prose accuracy; reviewer-recorded decisions do not prove author intent. Overall impact warnings/omission reasons still lack export parity. Historical failures and later reported checks remain separately attributed in the research ledger.

The gallery is independent of the application: no provider, renderer, resolver, session workflow or model is replaced. No network requests, analytics, persistence or external assets are needed to open it. External evidence links connect only when you choose them. Search and filter choices last only for this open page. Print uses the full feature collection.
